items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: Sanford is the youngest. Youngest. And he's how much younger than you? ... He was born, I think that was in 1903. Mm-hmm. 1903 was born. He was born the year that my daddy died.

ctx.x: Yeah. They all played trombos, string bass, guitar, mandolin. And my second, the fellow under me used to play guitar, only. That was Henry. And my younger brother, he played with Pangelline for a while. He played trap drums.

And what's his name? Sanford. Sanford. They call him Sam? Sam. Sam. And what's the difference in ages there? Oh, I'll be 73 pretty soon. And how old would Leonce be if he were alive? Leonce would be about 68. So you're the oldest. I'm the oldest. And Sanford is the youngest. Youngest. And he's how much younger than you?
Oh, plenty younger. He was born, I think that was in 1903. Mm-hmm. 1903 was born. He was born the year that my daddy died.
